senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. קבב s. v. קַב)to bore, perforate.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 97b:4">Snh. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>מקרא זה נוֹקֵב וכ׳</he> this verse bores and penetrates to the depth.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 6b">Ib. 6ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>יִקּוֹב הדין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D00635"><he>דִּין</he> II</cite>; a. e.—Part. pass. <cite ref="N01172"><he>נָקוּב</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="N01174"><he>נְקוּבָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>נְקוּבִים</he>, <he>נְקוּבִין</he>; <he>נְקוּבוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:3">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:3">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> top; (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:2">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>נקופה</he>), v. <cite ref="A03034"><he>אָרוֹן</he></cite>.
Cant. R. to VIII, 5 מצאתי חככם נ׳ וכ׳ I found your palate perforated, unable to receive blessings.—Esp. נקובה the case of an animal found to have a vital organ perforated.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> <he>נְקוּבַת הושט</he>, v. <cite ref="F00096"><he>וֶשֶׁט</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:15">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite> bot. (reported as one of the changes adopted in the Greek translation of the Pentateuch, ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 1:27">Gen. I, 27</cite>, a.

V, 2) זכר ונְקוּבָיו בראם a male with corresponding female parts created he them; Gen. R. s. 8; Mekh. Bo, s. 14 (v. Gen. R. l. c., beg.).—[Y. Meg. I, 71ᶜ לנקוביו, v. נֶקֶב.]—2) (cmp. אָרַר) to curse, blaspheme.

Snh. 56ᵃ (ref. to Lev. XXIV, 16) ממאי דהאי נוֹקֵב וכ׳ whence do you prove that this noḳeb is used in the sense of blasphemy?… perhaps it means to perforate? Ib. למימרא דנוקב וכ׳ to indicate that noḳeb means curse.

senses.gloss: to point out, to pronounce. Ib. אימא פרושי שמיה חוא I might say, noḳeb means uttering His name (the Tetragrammaton)? Tanḥ. Emor 24 התחיל לִנְקוֹב וכ׳ he began to pronounce the Name and curse Him.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. I ונקובות ידים; ed. Bub. נקיבת ירק, read: קְנִיבַת ירק, v. קְנִיבָה.]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> <he>הריאה שנִיקְּבָה</he> if a lung is found to be perforated.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ib.</cite> <he>עד שתִּינָּקֵב וכ׳</he> until the puncture reaches &c. Ib. 43ᵃ <he>נ׳ זה בלא זה</he> if only one of the two is perforated.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:6">Bekh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>אם נִקְּבוּ זה וכ׳</he> if there is a perforation going from one channel to the other; a. fr.
